notes.title: The release date for the final chapter is here!
notes.notes:
RELEASE DATE ANNOUNCEMENT! 😱🥰


We're excited to announce that the conclusion to our narratively-driven aventure series Reversion will be available on Steam February 28!

🔗 Add the game to your Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/281080

Reversion - The Return is the third and final chapter in the series which depicts a ruined Buenos Aires, in Argentina, in the year 2035. You will save your city by joining the Resistance against the villain Sergio.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6140506/6d291c92f65513c861be34447b479672da0f4137.png

For more information on Reversion visit the official site: http://3finteractive.net/#reversion

A list of features include: 

 Story-based gameplay - thought-provoking story with many twists and turns.
 Challenging puzzles - use your wits to solve a wide variety of puzzles along your journey. 
 Gather clues - search the collapsed city for clues to your past and how the city came to be in ruins.
 Character interaction - talk with an array of charismatic and mysterious characters to find out more about your past and how to be a valuable member of the resistance.
 Fully voice acted - the cast of Reversion is brought to life by talented voice actors.
 Classic hand-drawn 2D graphics.
 Cinematic hand-drawn cutscenes, full of epic story moments. 
 Stylized soundtrack inspired by traditional Argentinian music.

notes.title: Reversion: The Meeting new update: voices, animations and languages!
notes.notes:
Reversion Chapter 2 is now available with improvements here on Steam!

With the update that came earlier today for Reversion 2: The Meeting, you'll find new voices, animations and support for new languages.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4dWqHl9Gvoo

Change List:

 - New voice acting for Victoria, Sergio, Nicolás and some guards
 - Enhanced animations for Christian
 - Support for French (Windows, Linux and Mac) and Traditional Chinese (Windows)



Your adventure continues on the streets of Buenos Aires. It’s time for Reversion.


Check it: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/281060
